title: juicy italian egg supplì
description: an italian dish featuring egg noodles, steam, and a touch of wine. perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: cook the egg noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
add the parmesan and mozzarella cheese and stir until melted.
add the cooked egg noodles and toss with the cheese sauce.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
transfer the noodles to a serving dish and top with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
in a separate bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and black pepper.
pour the egg mixture over the noodles and sprinkle with grated mozzarella cheese.
transfer the egg supplì to a baking dish and bake at 375f for 15-20 minutes until set and golden brown.
remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
sprinkle with additional fresh basil leaves if desired.
